notices.title: Welcome to the New Academic Year
notices.content: We are pleased to welcome all students, faculty and staff to the new academic year 2026. This year promises exciting opportunities in academics, sports, and technology. Please check your respective portals for timetables and schedules.
notices.author: Academic Office

notices.title: Final Examination Schedule Released
notices.content: The final examination schedule for Semester 2 has been released. All students are advised to check the Examinations section for their hall ticket and exam timing details. No late entries will be permitted.
notices.author: Examination Cell

notices.title: Campus Maintenance — Sunday
notices.content: The main building, labs and administrative block will undergo routine maintenance this Sunday from 8AM to 4PM. All classes will be conducted in alternative blocks. Please check with your department for room allocations.
notices.author: Facilities Team

notices.title: Annual Sports Day Registration Open
notices.content: Registrations for the Annual Sports Day 2026 are now open. Students interested in participating in Athletics, Chess, Cricket, Football and other events must register through the Sports Officer portal before March 28th.
notices.author: Sports Department

notices.title: Fee Payment Deadline — March 31st
notices.content: All pending fee payments must be cleared before March 31st, 2026. Students with outstanding dues will not be permitted to appear in final examinations. Please visit the Payments section to clear your dues.
notices.author: Accounts Office
